scope: Tables and views declared by migrations that have no direct .from() consumer in current JS/TS runtime.
policy: Every current table/view candidate must be explicitly classified. Preserve entries require concrete SQL/data/domain evidence; pending_destructive_migration entries require a guarded migration and must not be applied to the active database without the deployment gate defined by the audit campaign.

administrative_fee_models.rationale: Legacy administrative-fee model superseded by markup_models; coordinated FK/table removal is already guarded in the destructive pricing convergence migration.

bdi_model_versions.rationale: Legacy BDI version layer. Existing SQL dependency is handled by the coordinated pricing migration; active budget versions do not use the legacy FK.

bdi_models.rationale: Legacy BDI model superseded by markup_models; empty and included in the guarded coordinated pricing migration.

contract_parties.rationale: Abandoned Stage 9 party schema superseded by the advanced signature signer architecture; guarded DROP aborts if rows appear.

cost_catalog_items.rationale: Cost-engine catalog table consumed transitively by SQL functions and protected by relational constraints/triggers.

cost_compositions.rationale: Cost composition engine surface with SQL function consumers and relational integrity machinery.

document_types.rationale: Populated reference catalog referenced by document_module_types, document_templates and emitted_documents.

finance_settlements.rationale: Operational finance settlement ledger consumed by SQL functions and a dependent view; direct JS access is intentionally unnecessary.

fixed_costs.rationale: Empty legacy table; canonical fixed-cost representation is budget_items.cost_type='FIXED'. Guarded DROP verifies no standalone SQL reference or data appears.

inventory_asset_current_v.rationale: Inventory current-custody projection used by inventory SQL API.

inventory_asset_custodies.rationale: Custody history participates in inventory SQL functions, triggers and a dependent view.

inventory_assets.rationale: Core asset register with extensive SQL, FK, trigger and view dependencies.

inventory_events.rationale: Populated immutable/operational inventory event history with heavy SQL use.

inventory_expiry_alerts_v.rationale: Inventory expiry projection consumed by SQL dashboard/alert logic.

inventory_item_totals_v.rationale: Superseded inventory aggregate view with no JS, function or view consumer; guarded DROP prepared without CASCADE.

inventory_reservation_lines.rationale: Reservation detail surface used by reservation recalculation, stock views and SQL inventory operations.

inventory_reserved_stock_v.rationale: Transitively active: feeds inventory_available_stock_v, which is consumed by reservation/dashboard/movement functions.

inventory_stock_v.rationale: Canonical stock projection with multiple function and downstream-view consumers.

inventory_stocktake_lines.rationale: Stocktake detail table used by SQL posting/validation functions and protected by triggers/policies.

object_definition_versions.rationale: Object Runtime schema/version infrastructure; deliberately latent while runtime query/write gates are completed.

object_field_slots.rationale: Object Runtime slot allocation metadata used by deterministic SQL helpers.

object_record_followers.rationale: Object Runtime follower relation; intentionally schema-driven and dormant until the runtime surface is fully enabled.

object_records.rationale: Partitioned canonical Object Runtime record store; not an orphan. Dynamic partitions are correctly masked by the auditor.

operational_event_types.rationale: Populated operational-event type catalog referenced by operational event records and SQL creation flow.

procurement_events.rationale: Procurement event/audit surface written and consumed through SQL functions; zero current rows does not make it obsolete.

proposal_discount_decisions.rationale: Commercial approval decision history consumed by proposal/budget SQL workflow.

quality_form_events.rationale: Quality form event history used by version/freeze/submission SQL workflow.

report_events.rationale: Populated reporting event/audit history; snapshot hardening migration now stores only stable failure codes.

report_executive_kpis_v.rationale: Superseded executive KPI view with no runtime, SQL-function or downstream-view consumer; guarded DROP prepared without CASCADE.

report_exports.rationale: Populated report export/audit ledger used by report export workflow.

report_project_kpis_v.rationale: Project KPI projection has a SQL function consumer and a dependent view.

rh_benefit_payroll_exports.rationale: Lote de exportação de benefícios para a folha do Projeto RH (PR #42). A ausência de consumidor JS/TS é o desenho, não abandono: o módulo escreve e lê por RPC, e a tabela aparece 7 vez(es) em corpo de função. `estimatedRows` é 0 porque a migration correspondente ainda NÃO foi aplicada (débito declarado em diretrizes/migrations-aplicadas.json); a contagem real só existe depois da aplicação controlada.
